title: Progressive Random Convolutions for Single Domain Generalization
mechanism: Repeated application of one small random conv block (with deformable offsets and affine) grows augmentation diversity without destroying semantics.
adaptation: Zero the deformable offsets (they move 1-2 px cracks off their labels). Run as the alternative to GIN in the same arm family.
min_experiment: PF + Pro-RandConv (no offsets) vs PF + GIN arm; keep the better on val/F51; kill if neither beats PF by +0.03 E1 relF1@2.
